'''2019 European Championship Day 2 Nelson Cazon DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nelson Cazon]] at [[2019 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Nelson Cazon]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Cazon DS 2019 EC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127141514/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2019-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
